```{r global_options, include=FALSE}
theme_set(theme_classic(base_size = 13))

# =========================
# Paths
# =========================
data_dir <- "/Users/antina/Desktop/LPS/images"

nucleus_file <- file.path(data_dir, "IF1_nucleus_measurements_V2.txt")
endfeet_file <- file.path(data_dir, "IF1_endfeet_measurements_V2.txt")
process_file <- file.path(data_dir, "IF1_process_measurements_V2.txt")
vessel_file  <- file.path(data_dir, "IF1_vesselring_measurements_V2.txt")
diam_file    <- "/Users/antina/Desktop/LPS/images/vessel_diameter_master.tsv"

# =========================
# Utilities
# =========================
fix_names <- function(df) {
  bad <- names(df) == "" | is.na(names(df))
  names(df)[bad] <- paste0("col_", seq_len(sum(bad)))
  df
}

safe_factor <- function(x, levels = NULL) {
  if (is.null(levels)) factor(x) else factor(x, levels = levels)
}

p_to_stars <- function(p) {
  case_when(
    p < 0.001 ~ "***",
    p < 0.01 ~ "**",
    p < 0.05 ~ "*",
    TRUE ~ "ns"
  )
}

make_condition_annotations <- function(model, df, yvar) {
  ann <- as.data.frame(emmeans(model, pairwise ~ condition | region)$contrasts)
  names(ann) <- tolower(names(ann))
  ann <- ann %>%
    mutate(group1 = "VEH", group2 = "LPS", p_label = p_to_stars(p.value))

  ymax <- df %>%
    group_by(region) %>%
    summarise(y.position = max(.data[[yvar]], na.rm = TRUE) * 1.10, .groups = "drop")

  left_join(ann, ymax, by = "region")
}

make_mouse_colors <- function(df) {
  mouse_ids <- sort(unique(as.character(df$mouse)))
  
  veh_mice <- mouse_ids[grepl("^V|^veh|^VEH", mouse_ids)]
  lps_mice <- mouse_ids[grepl("^L|^lps|^LPS", mouse_ids)]
  
  # if mouse IDs themselves do not contain VEH/LPS, assign by data
  if (length(veh_mice) == 0 || length(lps_mice) == 0) {
    mouse_map <- df %>%
      distinct(mouse, condition) %>%
      mutate(mouse = as.character(mouse), condition = as.character(condition))
    
    veh_mice <- mouse_map %>% filter(condition == "VEH") %>% pull(mouse) %>% unique() %>% sort()
    lps_mice <- mouse_map %>% filter(condition == "LPS") %>% pull(mouse) %>% unique() %>% sort()
  }
  
  veh_cols <- if (length(veh_mice) > 0) {
    setNames(colorRampPalette(c("#9ecae1", "#08519c"))(length(veh_mice)), veh_mice)
  } else {
    c()
  }
  
  lps_cols <- if (length(lps_mice) > 0) {
    setNames(colorRampPalette(c("#fcbba1", "#a50f15"))(length(lps_mice)), lps_mice)
  } else {
    c()
  }
  
  c(
    "VEH" = "#2166ac",
    "LPS" = "#b2182b",
    veh_cols,
    lps_cols
  )
}

plot_violin_region <- function(df, yvar, title_text, ylab_text, ann_df) {

  my_cols <- make_mouse_colors(df)

  ggplot(df, aes(x = region, y = .data[[yvar]])) +

    geom_violin(
      aes(color = condition),
      fill = NA,
      linewidth = 0.6,
      trim = FALSE,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ) +

    geom_point(
      aes(color = mouse),
      shape = 15,
      size = 1.1,
      alpha = 0.9,
      position = position_jitter(width = 0.08),
      na.rm = TRUE
    ) +

    stat_summary(
      fun = mean,
      geom = "point",
      shape = 23,
      size = 2.5,
      fill = "white",
      color = "black",
      na.rm = TRUE
    ) +

    stat_summary(
      fun.data = mean_se,
      geom = "errorbar",
      width = 0.12,
      color = "black",
      linewidth = 0.4,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ) +

    ggpubr::stat_pvalue_manual(
      ann_df,
      label = "p_label",
      xmin = "group1",
      xmax = "group2",
      y.position = "y.position",
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      tip.length = 0.01,
      size = 5
    ) +

    facet_wrap(~condition, scales = "free_y") +
    scale_color_manual(values = my_cols) +
    theme_classic() +
    labs(title = title_text, x = "Region", y = ylab_text, color = "Mouse ID")
}

make_region_annotations <- function(model, df, yvar) {

  ann <- as.data.frame(emmeans(model, pairwise ~ region | condition)$contrasts)
  names(ann) <- tolower(names(ann))

  ann <- ann %>%
    separate(contrast, into = c("group1", "group2"), sep = " - ") %>%
    mutate(p_label = p_to_stars(p.value))

  ymax <- df %>%
    group_by(condition) %>%
    summarise(base_y = max(.data[[yvar]], na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

  ann <- left_join(ann, ymax, by = "condition") %>%
    group_by(condition) %>%
    mutate(y.position = base_y * (1.08 + 0.08 * row_number())) %>%
    ungroup()

  ann
}

plot_violin_condition <- function(df, yvar, title_text, ylab_text, ann_df) {
  
  my_cols <- make_mouse_colors(df)
  
  ggplot(df, aes(x = condition, y = .data[[yvar]])) +
    geom_violin(
      aes(color = condition),
      fill = NA,
      linewidth = 0.6,
      trim = FALSE,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ) +
    geom_point(
      aes(color = mouse),
      shape = 15,
      size = 1.1,
      alpha = 0.9,
      position = position_jitter(width = 0.08),
      na.rm = TRUE
    ) +
    stat_summary(
      fun = mean,
      geom = "point",
      shape = 23,
      size = 2.5,
      fill = "white",
      color = "black",
      na.rm = TRUE
    ) +
    stat_summary(
      fun.data = mean_se,
      geom = "errorbar",
      width = 0.12,
      color = "black",
      linewidth = 0.4,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ) +
    ggpubr::stat_pvalue_manual(
      ann_df,
      label = "p_label",
      xmin = "group1",
      xmax = "group2",
      y.position = "y.position",
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      tip.length = 0.01,
      size = 5
    ) +
    facet_wrap(~region, scales = "free_y") +
    scale_color_manual(values = my_cols) +
    theme_classic() +
    labs(title = title_text, x = NULL, y = ylab_text, color = "Mouse ID")
}

qq_band_plot <- function(x, title_text) {
  ggpubr::ggqqplot(
    data.frame(value = x),
    x = "value",
    conf.int = TRUE,
    conf.int.fill = "grey80",
    conf.int.alpha = 0.5,
    title = title_text,
    xlab = "Theoretical quantiles",
    ylab = "Sample quantiles"
  ) +
    theme_classic()
}

run_analysis <- function(df, raw_var, trans_var, model_trans, title_text, trans_label = "log1p") {

  model_raw <- lmer(
    as.formula(paste0(raw_var, " ~ condition * region + (1 | mouse/astro)")),
    data = df,
    REML = FALSE
  )

  cat("\n\n==============================\n")
  cat(title_text, "\n")
  cat("==============================\n\n")

  print(as.data.frame(VarCorr(model_trans)))
  print(anova(model_trans))

  tuk <- as.data.frame(
    emmeans(model_trans, pairwise ~ condition | region)$contrasts
  )
  print(tuk)
  
  cat("\nTukey post hoc: region within each condition\n")
  
  tuk_region <- as.data.frame(
    emmeans(model_trans, pairwise ~ region | condition)$contrasts
  )
  print(tuk_region)

  ann <- make_condition_annotations(model_trans, df, raw_var)

  p_condition <- plot_violin_condition(
    df = df,
    yvar = raw_var,
    title_text = title_text,
    ylab_text = title_text,
    ann_df = ann
  )
  print(p_condition)

  print(
    qq_band_plot(
      residuals(model_raw),
      paste("QQ plot before transformation -", title_text)
    )
  )

  print(
    qq_band_plot(
      residuals(model_trans),
      paste("QQ plot after", trans_label, "transformation -", title_text)
    )
  )
  
  ann_region <- make_region_annotations(model_trans, df, raw_var)
  p_region <- plot_violin_region(
    df = df,
    yvar = raw_var,
    title_text = paste(title_text, "- region comparison"),
    ylab_text = title_text,
    ann_df = ann_region
  )

  print(p_region)

  cat("\nShapiro test on raw-model residuals\n")
  print(shapiro.test(residuals(model_raw)))

  cat(paste0("\nShapiro test on ", trans_label, "-model residuals\n"))
  print(shapiro.test(residuals(model_trans)))

  cat("\nLevene test on raw values\n")
  print(car::leveneTest(df[[raw_var]] ~ interaction(df$condition, df$region)))

  cat(paste0("\nLevene test on ", trans_label, "-transformed values\n"))
  print(car::leveneTest(df[[trans_var]] ~ interaction(df$condition, df$region)))

  return(list(
    condition_plot = p_condition,
    region_plot = p_region
  ))
}
```

```{r import_data}
# =========================
# Import data
# =========================
nucl <- read.delim(nucleus_file, check.names = FALSE)
endf <- read.delim(endfeet_file, check.names = FALSE)
proc <- read.delim(process_file, check.names = FALSE)
vesr <- read.delim(vessel_file, check.names = FALSE)
diam <- read.delim(diam_file, check.names = FALSE)

nucl <- fix_names(nucl)
endf <- fix_names(endf)
proc <- fix_names(proc)
vesr <- fix_names(vesr)
diam <- fix_names(diam)

names(nucl) <- tolower(names(nucl))
names(endf) <- tolower(names(endf))
names(proc) <- tolower(names(proc))
names(vesr) <- tolower(names(vesr))
names(diam) <- tolower(names(diam))

nucl$image <- sub("-STAT3.*nuclear.*", "", nucl$label)
endf$image <- sub("-STAT3.*endfeet.*", "", endf$label)
proc$image <- sub("-STAT3.*process.*", "", proc$label)
vesr$image <- sub("-STAT3.*vesselring.*", "", vesr$label)

if (!"image" %in% names(diam)) {
  names(diam)[1:2] <- c("image", "diameter")
}

diam$diameter <- as.numeric(diam$diameter)

```

```{r summaries}
# =========================
# Build summaries
# =========================
nuclear_summary <- nucl %>%
  mutate(type = case_when(
    grepl("-STAT3-nuclear$", label) ~ "raw",
    grepl("-STAT3-thresholded-nuclear$", label) ~ "thr",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  )) %>%
  filter(!is.na(type)) %>%
  select(image, type, mean) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = type, values_from = mean) %>%
  rename(
    nuclear_stat3_mean = raw,
    nuclear_stat3_thr_mean = thr
  )

endfeet_summary <- endf %>%
  mutate(type = case_when(
    grepl("-STAT3-endfeet$", label) ~ "raw",
    grepl("-STAT3-thresholded-endfeet$", label) ~ "thr",
    grepl("-STAT3-area-endfeet$", label) ~ "area",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  )) %>%
  filter(!is.na(type)) %>%
  select(image, type, mean, area) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = type, values_from = c(mean, area)) %>%
  rename(
    endfeet_stat3_mean = mean_raw,
    endfeet_stat3_thr_mean = mean_thr,
    endfeet_stat3_area = area_area
  )

process_summary <- proc %>%
  mutate(type = case_when(
    grepl("-STAT3-process$", label) ~ "raw",
    grepl("-STAT3-thresholded-process$", label) ~ "thr",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  )) %>%
  filter(!is.na(type)) %>%
  select(image, type, mean) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = type, values_from = mean) %>%
  rename(
    process_stat3_mean = raw,
    process_stat3_thr_mean = thr
  )

vessel_summary <- vesr %>%
  mutate(type = case_when(
    grepl("-STAT3-vesselring$", label) ~ "raw",
    grepl("-STAT3-thresholded-vesselring$", label) ~ "thr",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  )) %>%
  filter(!is.na(type)) %>%
  select(image, type, mean) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = type, values_from = mean) %>%
  rename(
    vessel_stat3_mean = raw,
    vessel_stat3_thr_mean = thr
  )

```

```{r tables}
# =========================
# Build analysis table
# =========================
meta <- tibble(
  image = unique(c(
    nuclear_summary$image,
    endfeet_summary$image,
    process_summary$image,
    vessel_summary$image
  ))
) %>%
  separate(
    image,
    into = c("condition", "region", "mouse", "slice", "astro"),
    sep = "-",
    remove = FALSE
  )

analysis_df <- meta %>%
  left_join(diam %>% select(image, diameter), by = "image") %>%
  left_join(nuclear_summary, by = "image") %>%
  left_join(endfeet_summary, by = "image") %>%
  left_join(process_summary, by = "image") %>%
  left_join(vessel_summary, by = "image") %>%
  mutate(
    condition = safe_factor(condition, levels = c("VEH", "LPS")),
    region = safe_factor(region),
    mouse = safe_factor(mouse),
    slice = safe_factor(slice),
    astro = safe_factor(astro),
    
    endfeet_nuclear_ratio = endfeet_stat3_thr_mean / nuclear_stat3_thr_mean,
    process_nuclear_ratio = process_stat3_thr_mean / nuclear_stat3_thr_mean,
    endfeet_process_ratio = endfeet_stat3_thr_mean / process_stat3_thr_mean,
    endfeet_stat3_area = endfeet_stat3_area,
    
    log_nuclear_stat3 = log1p(nuclear_stat3_mean),
    log_endfeet_stat3 = log1p(endfeet_stat3_mean),
    log_process_stat3 = log1p(process_stat3_mean),
    log_vessel_stat3 = log1p(vessel_stat3_mean),
    
    log_endfeet_nuclear_ratio = log1p(endfeet_nuclear_ratio),
    log_process_nuclear_ratio = log1p(process_nuclear_ratio),
    log_endfeet_process_ratio = log1p(endfeet_process_ratio),
    log_endfeet_stat3_area = log1p(endfeet_stat3_area),
    sqrt_endfeet_nuclear_ratio = sqrt(endfeet_nuclear_ratio),
    log_diameter = log1p(diameter),
    stat3_total = endfeet_stat3_mean + nuclear_stat3_mean + process_stat3_mean,
    nucleus_total_ratio = nuclear_stat3_mean / stat3_total,
    endfeet_total_ratio = endfeet_stat3_mean / stat3_total,
    log_stat3_total = log1p(stat3_total),
    log_nucleus_total_ratio = log1p(nucleus_total_ratio),
    log_endfeet_total_ratio = log1p(endfeet_total_ratio),
)

analysis_df <- analysis_df %>%
  filter(!is.na(diameter), diameter <= 30)

glimpse(analysis_df)
```

```{r models}
# =========================
# Fit models
# Stats are done on LOG-transformed variables
# =========================
m_diameter <- lmer(
  log_diameter ~ condition * region + (1 | mouse/astro),
  data = df_diameter,
  REML = FALSE
)

m_nuclear <- lmer(
  log_nuclear_stat3 ~ condition * region + (1 | mouse/astro),
  data = df_nuclear,
  REML = FALSE
)

m_endfeet <- lmer(
  log_endfeet_stat3 ~ condition * region + (1 | mouse/astro),
  data = df_endfeet,
  REML = FALSE
)

m_process <- lmer(
  log_process_stat3 ~ condition * region + (1 | mouse/astro),
  data = df_process,
  REML = FALSE
)

m_vessel <- lmer(
  log_vessel_stat3 ~ condition * region + (1 | mouse/astro),
  data = df_vessel,
  REML = FALSE
)

m_ratio_en <- lmer(
  log_endfeet_nuclear_ratio ~ condition * region + (1 | mouse/astro),
  data = df_ratio_en,
  REML = FALSE
)

m_ratio_en_sqrt <- lmer(
  sqrt_endfeet_nuclear_ratio ~ condition * region + (1 | mouse/astro),
  data = df_ratio_en_sqrt,
  REML = FALSE
)

m_ratio_pn <- lmer(
  log_process_nuclear_ratio ~ condition * region + (1 | mouse/astro),
  data = df_ratio_pn,
  REML = FALSE
)

m_ratio_ep <- lmer(
  log_endfeet_process_ratio ~ condition * region + (1 | mouse/astro),
  data = df_ratio_ep,
  REML = FALSE
)

m_endfeet_area <- lmer(
  log_endfeet_stat3_area ~ condition * region + (1 | mouse/astro),
  data = df_endfeet_area,
  REML = FALSE
)

m_total <- lmer(
  log_stat3_total ~ condition * region + (1 | mouse/astro),
  data = df_total,
  REML = FALSE
)

m_ratio_nt <- lmer(
  log_nucleus_total_ratio ~ condition * region + (1 | mouse/astro),
  data = df_ratio_nt,
  REML = FALSE
)

m_ratio_et <- lmer(
  log_endfeet_total_ratio ~ condition * region + (1 | mouse/astro),
  data = df_ratio_et,
  REML = FALSE
)


```

```{r export_ppt}
ppt <- read_pptx()

add_plot_slide <- function(ppt, title, plot_obj) {
  ppt <- add_slide(ppt, layout = "Title and Content", master = "Office Theme")
  ppt <- ph_with(ppt, title, location = ph_location_type(type = "title"))
  ppt <- ph_with(ppt, dml(ggobj = plot_obj), location = ph_location_fullsize())
  ppt
}
```
